info.name: Producer API Collection - Advanced Size Management
info.description:
Complete API collection untuk Producer role dengan Advanced Size Management System. Includes produk, kategori, warna, material, dan hybrid size management (commits 83e9b26, dec3c0e).

🆕 NEW SIZE MANAGEMENT FEATURES:
• Advanced multi-size products dengan age categories (ANAK/DEWASA)
• Aggregated size display dengan breakdown capabilities
• Business logic validation dan performance monitoring
• Hybrid architecture: legacy + advanced size support
• Real-time aggregation dengan caching (5min TTL)

🔗 DEPENDENCIES & EXECUTION ORDER:
1. Setup: Login → Get session token
2. Prerequisites: Create Category → Create Color → (Optional) Create Material
3. Products: Create/Update products dengan size management
4. Size Management: Test aggregation, validation, hybrid scenarios
5. Testing: Run comprehensive integration scenarios

📋 REQUIRED VARIABLES:
- base_url: http://localhost:3000
- clerk_session_token: From browser cookies
- Auto-captured: product_id, category_id, color_id, material_id, size_id

⚡ PERFORMANCE TARGETS:
- Aggregation: <50ms calculation time
- Cache Hit Rate: >80% untuk optimal performance
- Response Time: <2s SLA maintained

📚 Full documentation: docs/api/manage-product-endpoints.md | docs/api/manage-product-business-logic.md

request.description:
Membuat produk baru dengan hybrid size management system, color, dan material fields plus upload gambar. 

🆕 SIZE MANAGEMENT OPTIONS:
• Legacy Mode (hasSizes=false): Single size field untuk backward compatibility
• Advanced Mode (hasSizes=true): Multiple sizes dengan age categories (ANAK/DEWASA)
• Material fields opsional untuk perhitungan otomatis biaya material
• Auto-aggregation: Total quantity dihitung otomatis dari sizes array

📋 VALIDATION RULES:
• Jika hasSizes=true, field sizes wajib diisi
• Age categories: ANAK atau DEWASA
• Sizes: S, M, L, XL, XXL
• Quantity total = sum of all size quantities
